description:
Update the metadata for three specific machine learning papers in your Zotero library to catalog them as arXiv preprints. For each of the following papers, set the 'Library Catalog' field to 'arXiv' and the 'Call Number' field to the specified ID:

1. 'Attention Is All You Need' -> Library Catalog: 'arXiv', Call Number: '1706.03762'
2. 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers...' -> Library Catalog: 'arXiv', Call Number: '1810.04805'
3. 'Generative Adversarial Nets' -> Library Catalog: 'arXiv', Call Number: '1406.2661'

You will need to locate each paper in the library and edit the fields in the Info pane on the right. Scroll down in the Info pane to find these specific fields.
